description: PR-2 golden expectations for NPC script compatibility fixes, updated from the PR-1 characterization baseline.

cases.name: take_give_legacy_coin_token_current_item_baseline
cases.current_behavior: The localized legacy coin token is resolved as gold, not as an inventory item name.

cases.name: checkmonmap_current_name_count_baseline
cases.current_behavior: CHECKMONMAP with two tokens is interpreted as map-id plus required monster count.

cases.name: checkhum_current_count_only_baseline
cases.current_behavior: CHECKHUM with two tokens is interpreted as map-id plus required player count.

cases.name: monclear_current_name_baseline
cases.current_behavior: MONCLEAR treats the first token as a target map id and clears monsters on that map.

cases.name: istakeitem_current_checkitem_baseline
cases.current_behavior: ISTAKEITEM checks the item name most recently removed by TAKE/TAKEW within the same script execution context.

cases.name: takecheckitem_current_name_delete_baseline
cases.current_behavior: TAKECHECKITEM currently deletes by requested item name instead of deleting the concrete item found by the preceding CHECKITEM.
